verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP APIs server that gives external, authorized access to the graph once enabled in Features. It also offers a `logseq://` x-callback protocol for third-party apps to invoke actions, plus plugin APIs. However, the API runs only locally against the desktop app, the plugin API reference is community-driven rather than official, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), official first-party API reference, remote/hosted API access, hands-on corroboration of agents driving the API.
